_metadata.description: MaplePy reference library: oxidation state overrides, Hoppe reference MAPLE values, and isostructural series constants.
_metadata.author: Reeves-McLaren, N.
notes: oxidation_state_overrides: formula-keyed assignments for stoichiometrically unambiguous compounds whose elements have multiple entries in common_oxidation_states.json. Level 4 of the oxidation state chain in MaplePy 1.3.6 (after the user's states and the CIF's own, before the single-state fallback). Keys use pymatgen reduced_formula convention (no spaces).
reference_maple: Hoppe reference values for binary and selected ternary compounds, for checking computed values. Sources cited per entry.

isostructural_series: MAPLE x d_ref constants (kcal/mol.Ang) for well-characterised isostructural families. Constant within a structure type for all members; deviations flag topological errors or anomalous bonding.
mixed_valence_compounds: formulas explicitly excluded from oxidation_state_overrides because they contain sites with more than one oxidation state. Listed here to document the deliberate exclusion.
v1.0.1: the notes describe MaplePy 1.3.6; one series note removed. No override or value has changed.

oxidation_state_overrides._note: Keys: pymatgen reduced_formula. Values: {element: formal_charge}. Only compounds where charge balance uniquely determines all oxidation states. Compounds with mixed-valence or ambiguous anion states are excluded and listed in mixed_valence_compounds.

mixed_valence_compounds._note: Compounds explicitly excluded from oxidation_state_overrides. Charge balance is ambiguous or requires site-specific assignment. MAPLE calculation requires user-supplied oxidation_states dict.
mixed_valence_compounds.FeS2: Assigned Fe2+/S- (pyrite) in overrides; alternative Fe4+/S2- assignment exists, verify before use

reference_maple._note: Hoppe reference MAPLE values (kcal/mol per formula unit). Used to validate computed values and for additivity testing without requiring the user to compute binaries. All values from Hoppe (1966) or Hoppe (1995) unless noted.

BaO_rocksalt._note: Binary sum BaO+TiO2 from Hoppe 1995 p.560; individual BaO value back-calculated

isostructural_series._note: MAPLE x d_ref (kcal/mol.Ang): constant within an isostructural family. Deviations flag topological errors or anomalous bonding (wrong structure type, wrong CN). madelung_factor is dimensionless and also invariant within the family.

rock_salt_AO_alkaline_earth.description: Alkaline earth oxides MO in Fm-3m (NaCl type). MAPLE x d_ref constant across MgO, CaO, SrO, BaO.

rock_salt_AX_MF.description: NaCl-type structures: Madelung factor invariant at 1.7476 for all AB compositions in Fm-3m.
rock_salt_AX_MF.notes: MF deviation from 1.7476 in an Fm-3m structure indicates incorrect topology assignment or severe positional error.

zinc_blende_AX_MF.description: Zinc blende (F-43m / F4-3m) structures: Madelung factor 1.6381.
zinc_blende_AX_MF.notes: MF=1.638 in a structure claimed to be NaCl-type (MF should be 1.748) is a diagnostic fingerprint for a zinc blende mis-assignment. See SnTe ICSD 53956.

corundum_A2X3_MF.description: Corundum-type (R-3c): Madelung factor ~25.0 (structure-dependent, use as guide only).
corundum_A2X3_MF.notes: Madelung factor less diagnostic for corundum than for cubic structure types due to structural degrees of freedom.
